description: baseline: k-mer TF-IDF (3–6-mers) + LightGBM with balanced class weights — step 2 of the sequence ladder for variable-length DNA sequences (300–1000 chars, N=50k)

Switch from k-mer TF-IDF + LightGBM to 1D residual CNN on one-hot-encoded DNA sequences (step 3 of ladder), with focal loss (gamma=2, alpha=inverse class freq) to address 21x class imbalance, AdamW + cosine LR, and mixed-precision training for speed

Upgraded CNN to multi-scale dilated architecture with SE attention and attention pooling, added reverse complement augmentation (50% prob), and replaced uniform DataLoader with WeightedRandomSampler to heavily oversample the 21x-imbalanced minority class 2 — all key improvements for DNA classification with severe class imbalance

description: Fixed SyntaxError (prose text in train.py), fixed num_workers=0, upgraded to multi-scale dilated CNN with dilation (1,2,4), added TTA with reverse complement, label smoothing, OneCycleLR, and random crop augmentation

Fixed bugs (prose text + num_workers=2), increased MAX_LEN to 800 to capture more sequence info, switched from focal loss to standard cross-entropy paired solely with WeightedRandomSampler (avoiding double imbalance correction that regressed exp 3), and added TTA with reverse complement

Switch to frozen DNABERT-6 pretrained DNA transformer (step 4 of ladder) with mean-pool embeddings, RC-invariant TTA at val time, and MLP head — CNN has plateaued at 0.542 and pretrained DNA representations should provide a significant quality jump

Added SNP-like random mutation augmentation (30% prob, 2% rate) + random window selection to increase minority class 2 effective diversity, added label smoothing (0.05), and extended training to 60 epochs with patience 15

Replaced CNN-only architecture with CNN-BiGRU hybrid (multi-scale CNN extracts local motifs → BiGRU captures long-range sequential dependencies → max+mean pooling), increased MAX_LEN from 800→1000 for full sequence coverage, keeping WRS + RC/mutation augmentation from exp 6

DRW (Deferred Re-Weighting) strategy: Phase 1 (epochs 1–48) trains with WRS + cross-entropy to build strong representations, Phase 2 (epochs 49–80) switches to focal loss (gamma=2, alpha=inverse_freq) while keeping WRS to aggressively fine-tune for the 21x-minority class 2, with patience reset at transition — same CNN architecture as best exp 6.

Train 2 independent CNN models (same exp 6 architecture/hyperparams) with different random seeds and ensemble their TTA predictions — averaging 4 views total (2 seeds × fwd+RC) to reduce variance caused by the 21x class imbalance on the 1143-sample minority class 2.

Added within-class Mixup augmentation for minority class 2 (40% prob, Beta(0.4,0.4)) to diversify its 914 training samples beyond WRS repetition, and upgraded to triple pooling (attention+max+avg concatenated → 768d head) for richer global sequence representations.
Added 3rd ensemble seed (123) with N_EPOCHS reduced from 60→55 to fit 3×model budget (~1680s), extending the proven 2→3 seed variance reduction strategy that gave +0.009 improvement in exp 9

Added Stochastic Weight Averaging (manual, epochs 40–60 averaged) with BN recalibration to the 2-seed CNN ensemble — averaging late-training checkpoints finds flatter minima near cosine-LR convergence, returning SWA or best-regular checkpoint whichever scores higher on val

Heterogeneous ensemble — exact exp 9 CNN (2 seeds, MAX_LEN=800, 60 epochs, WRS+TTA) plus k-mer TF-IDF LightGBM combined at 70/30 ratio; CNN captures local positional motifs while LGBM captures global k-mer statistics, providing complementary signals especially for minority class 2

Fixed SyntaxError (removed prose from line 1), kept proven 2-seed CNN ensemble (exp 9), added heterogeneous LGBM with improved (3,6) k-mers + 12k features + 300 trees for complementary global sequence composition signal alongside CNN's local positional motifs

Upgraded LGBM with (3,6)-mers (12k features), 25 biological features (GC%, CpG ratio, dinucleotide frequencies), 400 trees at lr=0.05 and 63 leaves — richer DNA-specific signal should improve minority class 2 discrimination alongside unchanged 2-seed CNN ensemble

Upgraded LGBM with (3,6) k-mers + 10k features + 500 trees + 63 leaves, expanded bio features to 90 via vectorized trinucleotide frequencies (64 new features), and shifted ensemble weight to 65/35 CNN/LGBM to better leverage the stronger LGBM

Restored proven exp 15 LGBM settings (12k 3-6-mer features, 400 trees, 63 leaves, 70/30 weight) that were degraded in exp 16, removed trinucleotide features that caused overfitting, and added RC-invariant k-mer averaging for LGBM (averaging forward+reverse-complement TF-IDF vectors) to reduce strand orientation bias — matching the RC augmentation benefit already used by the CNN

Removed RC-invariant k-mer averaging (hurt in exp 17), and genuinely implemented the long-described LGBM upgrade to (3,6)-mers with 12k features + 400 trees + 63 leaves (previous experiments described these settings but code actually used only 3-5k features and 200 trees)

Fixed critical LGBM bugs (ngram_range was (3,5)/5k→(3,6)/12k, n_estimators 200→400, num_leaves 31→63 restoring proven exp15 settings), plus added a 2nd LGBM model (500 trees, 95 leaves, lr=0.03, seed=123) for diversity — dual-LGBM avg before 70/30 CNN blend
